positioning.statement: Playworlds: Voice-First AI Adventure RPG for D&D Players

keywordSpine.userAction: choose a role and state an action

supportingKeywords: ai adventure rpg for d&d players
positioning.intent: Help adult D&D players understand how a pressured role creates an immediate campaign decision, then evaluate Playworlds as a voice-first single-player AI adventure RPG

passageArchitecture.rule: Every section must make complete sense when retrieved in isolation. Each H2 names the subject and each opening sentence directly answers it.
passageArchitecture.signatureModule: Signal Fold Mission Archive + Signal Lock — Want / Secret / Decision
antiPatterns: full-bleed person with left-aligned poster copy
copying a franchise character, emblem, costume, world, or mission

observedPagePatterns.learning: Treat the current Steam listing as the product source of truth: Playworlds is an online, single-player, voice-first AI adventure RPG with voice or text input, a responsive AI game master, an in-world companion, persistent campaigns, and a Q3 2026 Early Access release target.
Define the category in the first screen and show playable story pressure before long product explanation.
Separate role choice, story premise, and participation into independently understandable modules.
Use mission state and objectives as the visual grammar instead of generic feature cards.
Give the visitor an immediate original world, role identity, and story conflict.
Use complete answer-first H2 passages and self-contained FAQ responses.

research.limits: Public search visibility and page structure do not prove traffic, rankings, clicks, or conversion performance. The Q3 2026 release window and Early Access feature set are time-sensitive and must be rechecked against Steam before publication.

googleTrends.interpretation: None of the exact candidate phrases appeared in the available US Top Rising feed. Each exact miss is a valid not_observed result, never proof of zero demand, and it does not block publication by itself. Publication still requires a current-day signed collection; missing, unavailable, or unverifiable provider evidence remains fail-closed.

evidenceRecords.statement: Playworlds is described as an online, single-player, voice-first AI adventure RPG.
Players can speak or type their actions, and a microphone is optional.
A responsive AI game master interprets actions, describes outcomes, and presents new choices, risks, and opportunities.
An in-world AI companion can talk, plan, and adventure with the player from a role inside the story.
Players can create, save, and resume persistent campaigns.
The announced RPG state includes player and party status, action resolution, dice results, inventory, and journey history.
Steam lists Playworlds as coming soon in Q3 2026 for Early Access.

productTruth.supportedBridge: Playworlds accepts voice or text actions in an online, single-player AI adventure RPG, with a responsive AI game master, an in-world companion, persistent campaigns, tracked RPG state, and generated dialogue and narration.
explicitExclusions: No claim that the three editorial missions or characters are available in Playworlds
No official D&D affiliation, endorsement, licensing, or 5e compatibility claim
No multiplayer or human-party claim; the Steam product description is single-player and the in-world companion is AI
No claim that Playworlds is released or available to play now; Steam currently lists Q3 2026 Early Access
No voice cloning, voice transformation, scoring, latency, privacy, or safety guarantee
No guarantee that AI-generated dialogue, narration, or gameplay responses will be consistent

conceptIpBoundary.allowedReference: D&D appears only as an adult tabletop-audience reference and in an explicit non-affiliation statement. It is not used as a product identity, rules claim, compatibility claim, setting, or content source.
forbiddenReferences: named D&D settings, characters, monsters, rules text, or artwork
conceptIpBoundary.visualStatement: Ilexa Vant, Moro Qel, Calyx Orra, the Kyr-Vanta Relay, their costumes, symbols, and missions are original editorial inventions. They are not represented as confirmed Playworlds content. Exact-name collision checks were run before release drafting.

designDirection.human: Adult English-speaking AI roleplay searchers who want a cinematic story hook they can understand immediately.
designDirection.action: Inspect three original mission signals, understand the Playworlds product format, and recognize the future Steam wishlist action without activating it inside the protected preview.
designDirection.feel: Mature orbital noir with cold signal telemetry, existential urgency, and no child-directed fantasy styling.
designDirection.visualSignature: A diagonal signal fold connects the hero, mission archive, role framework, and closing boundary while particles and mist remain atmospheric rather than decorative card chrome.

userDirection.request: Retire the previous product bridge, make Playworlds the product destination, and remove every old product reference from this concept page while keeping the project aimed at adult D&D audiences.

production.evidence: The LoreLens homepage, canonical metadata, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml were verified on the production revision, which also contains the signed Playworlds callback receiver contract. This proves the site origin and receiver deployment, not publication of this concept page, callback configuration, or a product-side handshake.

searchConsole.evidence: The service account has Full permission on the exact URL-prefix property and the Search Console API query succeeds without the previous 403. An observed empty result is valid evidence of zero returned rows, not an unavailable state.

attributedOutbound.evidence: The tracked renderer and redirect contract are implemented, but the route resolves only a valid page from data/pages. A non-writing production HEAD request for this unpublished concept slug returned 404 on 2026-08-18, as required before guarded publication.

Produce a same-day 8–12-candidate research set, durable report, digest-bound editorial review, visual audit, and guarded publication artifacts
